stories.seo_title: Claude Diffed Windows USB Traces to Write Linux Drivers
stories.seo_description: A developer who had abandoned a Plustek OpticFilm 8200i Linux driver got it working in hours by having Claude diff Windows and Linux USB traces.

stories.seo_title: Goodfire's Cammarata Argues Neural Networks Are Already Legible
stories.seo_description: Cammarata reports 99–100% of InceptionV1's last-layer neurons are easily interpretable after architecture fixes, arguing polysemanticity was not superposition.

stories.seo_title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open weights under $20M API revenue trigger
stories.seo_description: Meta released weights for Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter natively multimodal model with 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context.
